description: NYC Triple Choc Cookies 🍪 Ingredients:  120g Butter (Room Temp) 1 Egg 1tsp Vanilla  110g White Sugar  160g Dark Brown Sugar  170g Plain Flour  60g Cocoa Powder  200g Baking Chocolate (mix of dark, milk and white)  Fudge Pieces (optional) Pinch of Bicarbonate Soda Sprinkle of Salt Recipe:  - Whisk your room temp butter until silky, and light in colour (around 5-10mins)  - Add your sugars and whisk until combined  - Whisk in your egg and vanilla  - Sift in your dry ingredients and combine into a dough  - Chop your baking chocolate into chunks and shards - Mix your chocolate and fudge pieces into the dough. Save some for the topping  - Refrigerate your dough balls for a minimum of an hour, best over night! (Or freeze them)  - Preheat your oven and the baking tray at 180C  - Bake your cookies at 180C between 10-12mins. Depending on your batch, check it at 10 mins, if the base is cooked then they’re ready  - Let the cookies cool down as they’ll come out super soft, they will harden as they cool and become fudgey  - Sprinkle with some flakey salt  - - - - - - #nishatcooks #cookies #nyccookies #crumbl #cookierecipe #easybaking #baking #chocolatechipcookies #chocolatecookies
